The MACD histogram also showed improvement, strengthening the uptrend. A Higher Low pattern formed, with the 5-day low (96,825) higher than the 20-day low (82,500).

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position vs SMA100 (110,925 KRW)/SMA200 (89,241 KRW) — above long-term and very long-term trends
· 52-week position (61.2%) + current price range in historical middle ground
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.7→51.9) — exiting oversold, confirming upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (371.8626→1892.2889) — improving, bullish expansion signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 102,465 KRW) — near middle band, bandwidth 25.55% indicating moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (82,500 KRW) — based on Pivot S1 (89,693 KRW) and SMA200 (89,241 KRW)
· Swing resistance level (126,170 KRW) — potential for further upside on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — recovery signal, potential trend reversal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.48x) — subdued confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — buy entry conditions met
